description: This file defines the interface 'ProductReviewService', which extends a generic service interface and provides method signatures for managing product reviews, including retrieval by customer, product, language, and combinations thereof.

classes.name: ProductReviewService
classes.description: Interface for product review related operations extending generic entity service.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews for a specific product in a specific language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a product review for a specific product and customer by their IDs.
